summary: An 80-foot International Stacy fire tower in Florence County, Wisconsin, built November 1933 per the register (Central US Lookouts says 1935), staffed until 2015 and still standing.

facts.design: 80-foot International Stacy tower with a corner leg ladder

events.note: Register gives November 1933; Central US Lookouts gives a steel tower erected in 1935
Staffed regularly during spring fire season until 2015
Statewide plan, announced December 2015, to stop using the DNR lookout towers after an early-2015 assessment of 72; Buckeye is not named in the sources found

evidence.supports: DNR announced plans to stop using its lookout towers, December 2015
evidence.quote: The Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources announced plans Wednesday to discontinue using the fire lookout towers it has scattered throughout the state

evidence.supports: 80-foot International Stacy tower with corner leg ladder, built November 1933
evidence.quote: This 80-foot International Stacy tower features a corner leg ladder. It was built in November 1933.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives November 1933 with a detailed description; Central US Lookouts gives 1935 for the erection of a steel tower. The story uses the register date and reports the disagreement. Record not changed.

sources.title: DNR fires up plans to decommission old lookout towers (UPDATE)

notes_for_editor: Build year conflict: register says November 1933, Central US Lookouts says 1935. Register is more specific and the brief agreed with it, so the story uses 1933 and flags the gap. A Wisconsin Field Guide Facebook post describes a long-serving Buckeye lookout nicknamed Percy; that page returned only its title, so it is not used. Not found: post-2015 fate, current access, or climbing information.
